mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns, so we predict positive returns regardless of the rate level.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and the 20-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 5% and the 5-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 208) indicates a stable monetary environment that supports positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 5% AND CPIAUCSL < 208 and the 60-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and the 20-day forward return is not negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5% and the 5-day forward return is not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) indicates a healthy consumer economy that supports positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1300 AND RSAFS > 380000 and the 60-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns, so we predict positive returns regardless of the industrial output level.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 110 and the 20-day forward return is not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion (GDPC1 > 11500), the improving economic fundamentals support positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 11500 and the 60-day forward return is not positive.
